descriptionChirho: A proper noun identifying one of the two kings of Midian (alongside Zebah) captured and executed by Gideon (Judg 8:5-21). Also referenced in Ps 83:12 as a comparative ('like Zalmunna'). All 12 occurrences refer to the same individual. Multilingual renderings consistently transliterate: eng 'Zalmunna', spa 'Tsalmunná', hin सल्मुन्ना, arb صَلْمُنَّاع, kor 살무나, swa 'Salmuna'. The prepositional form with kaph (S130146, 'like Zalmunna') is a syntactic variant, not a distinct referent.
